name: Toono Senna
source:
The twin sister to Junna. Because their parents died in a car crash, Junna and her brother live together alone in a house. Senna and Junna support and rely on each other, and due to this Senna is very fond of her Onii-chan.

[from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/W_Wish]Wikipedia[/url]]
